scope: Batch 9 extraction from the undated official plane profile pages (magic.wizards.com/en/story/<plane>-plane). Each profile is a short overview written at some point in the plane's history, so the present tense on a page is that page's present, not today's; time-bound relations carry a limitation. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

claims.subject: nicol_bolas

evidence.quote: It's all as Nicol Bolas planned.
He came to Alara to feed on its rich mana and, in one massive ritual, restore its lost power as part of his multiplanar plan.

claims.summary: Nicol Bolas engineered the reunion of Alara's five shards to feed on its mana.

claims.subject: kaladesh

evidence.quote: The plane formerly known as Kaladesh has been reborn as Avishkar.
The plane is now united under a new planar government called the Avishkar Assembly

claims.summary: Kaladesh has been reborn as Avishkar and is governed by the Avishkar Assembly.
claims.limitation: The profile reflects the plane after the Consulate fell; the relation is plane-to-government.

claims.subject: renegades_kaladesh

evidence.quote: Their plan was thwarted by a rebel group known as the Renegades
The ruling Consulate has been overthrown in a popular, nearly bloodless revolution.

claims.summary: The Renegades thwarted the Consulate's plan, and the Consulate was later overthrown in a nearly bloodless revolution.
claims.limitation: The page does not say the Renegades alone carried out the overthrow.

claims.subject: paliano

evidence.quote: In the capital of Fiora—Paliano, the High City—murder and subterfuge are common.

claims.summary: Paliano, the High City, is the capital of Fiora.

claims.subject: selvala

evidence.quote: The explorer Selvala was one of the first to travel the frontier

claims.summary: Selvala was one of the first explorers of Fiora's wilderness frontier.
claims.limitation: The object is the Fioran frontier rather than the plane as a whole.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

evidence.quote: the powerful archangel Avacyn who was created by the Planeswalker Sorin Markov to safeguard humanity

claims.summary: Sorin Markov created the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity on Innistrad.

claims.subject: avacyn

evidence.quote: The Church is named for its leader, the powerful archangel Avacyn

claims.summary: Avacyn was the leader of the Church of Avacyn.
claims.limitation: Past state; the same page says Sorin later unmade her.

claims.subject: griselbrand

evidence.quote: First the demon Griselbrand trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him

claims.summary: The demon Griselbrand trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him.

claims.subject: sorin_markov

evidence.quote: Sorin Markov finally intervened, unmaking his beloved creation.

claims.summary: When madness overtook Avacyn, Sorin Markov unmade her.

claims.subject: takeshi_konda

evidence.quote: the daimyo Takeshi Konda, ruled over the Towabara Plains from his stronghold at Eiganjo

claims.summary: The daimyo Takeshi Konda ruled the Towabara Plains from his stronghold at Eiganjo.

claims.subject: o_kagachi

evidence.quote: Konda kidnapped a kami to secure his own power and immortality.
This outraged the great O-Kagachi, kami of all things

claims.summary: Konda kidnapped a kami for power and immortality, which outraged O-Kagachi and began the Kami War.
claims.limitation: The page says the kidnapping outraged O-Kagachi; direct opposition to Konda personally is inferred.

claims.subject: michiko_konda

evidence.quote: Only Konda's daughter Michiko and a stolen kami—an entity who calls herself Kyodai—have any hope of placating the kami

claims.summary: Michiko Konda and the stolen kami Kyodai are the only hope of ending the Kami War.
claims.limitation: The page presents them as the hope for peace; it does not narrate them acting together.

evidence.quote: Only Konda's daughter Michiko and a stolen kami

evidence.quote: for it was their queen, Oona, who caused it.

claims.limitation: The page says she caused the transformation; it does not describe how.

claims.subject: oona

evidence.quote: Long ago, this metal plane was created by Karn, the silver golem built by the Planeswalker Urza.
